headline: You won the job at a price. Nobody checked if the price held.
Materials ran over. Hours ran long. The quote never moved.
The job looked busy, so it must have been profitable. Was it?
Every unchecked job teaches you to underprice the next one.
The estimate becomes the budget. Real costs track against it as the job runs.
You see the overrun mid-job, while there's still time to act on it.
Same job. Different view of the margin.
before: Margin is a feeling at the end of the job.
after: Margin is a number you can see while the job is running.

headline: Estimate it once. Track it against real costs. Know your margin.
